faq.q: What is Andalusia Day and when is it in 2042?
faq.a: Andalusia Day (Día de Andalucía) is celebrated annually on 28 February, commemorating the 1980 autonomy referendum. In 2042, it falls on a Friday, making it a long weekend. It's a public holiday across Andalusia, with many locals and visitors heading to the coast for celebrations.

faq.q: Can I rent a boat in Marbella for Andalusia Day 2042?
faq.a: Yes, we offer a range of boats for charter from Puerto Banús. All departures are from Puerto Banús, and you can book for 2, 4, or 8 hours, depending on the boat. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, including skipper, drinks, and snacks.

faq.q: What is included in the boat rental price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden extras – the price you see is the total for the charter.

faq.q: Which boats are available for Andalusia Day 2042?
faq.a: We have 17 boats in our fleet, ranging from the 6.4m Mariah SX21 (5 guests) to the 29m Ferretti 94 (12 guests). Popular choices for celebrations include the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h), Azimut 39 (€749/2h), and the Mangusta 80 (from €4,719/4h, jet ski included).

faq.q: Can I bring my own food and drinks on board?
faq.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring additional food and drinks. However, note that our standard charter already includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. If you have specific requests, let us know when booking via WhatsApp.

faq.q: How do I book a boat for Andalusia Day 2042?
faq.a: For boats in Tier A (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) you can book directly via our website or WhatsApp. For all other boats, including the Mangusta 80, pricing is on request – send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred date and boat, and we'll confirm availability and quote.

faq.q: What is the weather like in Marbella on 28 February?
faq.a: Late February in Marbella typically sees daytime temperatures around 17–20°C, with plenty of sunshine. Sea conditions are usually calm, but it can be cooler on the water – bring a light jacket. If weather is poor, we can reschedule or offer a refund, subject to our policy.

faq.q: Are there any special offers for Andalusia Day 2042?
faq.a: For the long weekend, we recommend booking early. The Mangusta 80 (both white and grey) includes a free jet ski for charters of 4 hours or more. For other boats, we may offer flexible timing – contact us via WhatsApp for the latest availability and any promotions.

data.body_html:
Celebrate Andalusia Day 2042 in style with a private boat rental in Marbella. On Friday, 28 February 2042, the Costa del Sol comes alive with fiestas, and there's no better way to enjoy the holiday than from the deck of your own charter, cruising the Mediterranean. Departing from Puerto Banús, our fleet of 17 boats offers options for every group size and budget, with prices starting at €749 for 2 hours on the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39. All charters include a licensed skipper, drinks, snacks, and insurance – so you can focus on the celebration.

Why rent a boat for Andalusia Day in Marbella?

Andalusia Day marks the region's autonomy and is a public holiday across southern Spain. In 2042, it falls on a Friday, creating a long weekend – the perfect excuse to gather friends and family for a day on the water. A boat rental lets you escape the crowded beach clubs and enjoy the coastline at your own pace. From Puerto Banús, you can cruise towards Marbella's Golden Mile, drop anchor at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, or even head to Cabopino or Estepona for a longer voyage.

Andalusia Day 2042 – what to expect on the coast

Expect mild, sunny weather – average highs of 18°C in late February – and calm seas. The marina will be buzzing with locals and visitors alike. Many restaurants and beach clubs host special events, but from your boat you'll have a front-row seat to the action. Whether you want a relaxed afternoon with cava and tapas or a more adventurous trip with a jet ski (included on the Mangusta 80), we can tailor the day to your wishes.

Our fleet for Andalusia Day 2042

Choose from a range of motor yachts, flybridges, and speedboats. All depart from Puerto Banús. Here's a quick overview:

Top itineraries for your Andalusia Day cruise

From Puerto Banús, you have several scenic options:

  • Marbella coastline – Cruise past the Golden Mile, stop for a swim at Cala del Faro, and enjoy views of La Concha mountain.
  • Cabopino – Head east to the charming dunes of Cabopino, about 12 NM away, perfect for a quiet anchorage.
  • Estepona – Sail west to Estepona's old town, a 15 NM trip, and enjoy a leisurely lunch ashore.
  • Sotogrande – For a longer adventure, continue to Sotogrande marina, 25 NM from Puerto Banús.

Your skipper will recommend the best route based on weather and sea conditions.

What's included in every charter

We believe in transparent pricing. Every rental includes:

  • Licensed skipper (speaks English & Spanish)
  • Fuel for the entire charter
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (crisps, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

No extra charges for cleaning or docking – just bring your swimwear and sunscreen.

How to book your Andalusia Day 2042 boat

Booking is simple:

  1. Choose your preferred boat from our [fleet](/blog/marbella-boat-rental/).
  2. For Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, book directly online or via WhatsApp – price is fixed.
  3. For other boats, send us a WhatsApp message with your date and group size; we'll confirm availability and quote within hours.
  4. Pay a deposit to secure your slot – balance due on the day.

Given the popularity of the long weekend, we recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks in advance.
